scientific_question: Does the independently reproduced ARC-v5 trainability repair generalize to the frozen ARC-Challenge validation split under supervised CE training without returning to input-insensitive one-class collapse?
scope: development validation only; not confirmatory test evidence

dataset.name: allenai/ai2_arc ARC-Challenge
dataset.eligibility: exactly four answer choices; same frozen eligibility implementation as protocol v3
dataset.test_split_policy: must not be downloaded, opened, evaluated, or used for selection

conditions.legacy_ce: legacy LAMARCClassifier with quantization enabled and no v5 repair
conditions.repaired_v5_ce: explicit build_arc_v5_repaired_classifier with repair id arc-v5-stable-ema-residual-0.03125
conditions.repaired_v5_shuffled_labels: same repaired-v5 model trained on a deterministic seed-specific permutation of train labels; validation labels remain untouched

metrics.primary: mean repaired_v5_ce validation accuracy across five seeds
secondary: paired repaired_v5_ce minus legacy_ce accuracy by seed
paired repaired_v5_ce minus no_quantizer_ce accuracy by seed
mean logit variance across validation examples
bootstrap 95 percent interval over five seeds for repaired accuracy and paired deltas

predeclared_decision_rules.negative_control_valid: upper bootstrap 95 percent bound of repaired_v5_shuffled_labels mean accuracy must be below 0.35
predeclared_decision_rules.collapse_rejected: every repaired_v5_ce seed must predict at least two answer classes and no repaired_v5_ce seed may place more than 0.95 of validation examples into one predicted class
predeclared_decision_rules.generalization_supported_with_limitation: negative_control_valid and collapse_rejected and lower bootstrap 95 percent bound of repaired_v5_ce mean accuracy is above 0.25 and lower bootstrap 95 percent bound of paired repaired_v5_ce-minus-legacy_ce accuracy is above 0
predeclared_decision_rules.quantization_benefit_supported: lower bootstrap 95 percent bound of paired repaired_v5_ce-minus-no_quantizer_ce accuracy is above 0
predeclared_decision_rules.if_generalization_rule_fails: preserve a negative or inconclusive validation result; do not tune this repair family on validation
predeclared_decision_rules.if_negative_control_fails: mark the validation package invalid and do not interpret performance
